Hệ thống quản lý vận tải hàng hóa đường.en: The rail freight management system is one of the most important systems. Because this is a long-distance transport method, an enormous amount of goods. So if the freight system doesn't manage the regulation, smart, control of the cargo conditions will be difficult.
Hệ thống quản lý vận tải hàng hóa đường.zh: 铁路货运管理系统是最重要的系统之一. 因为这是一种长途运输方法,数量巨大的货物. 因此,如果货运系统不管理监管,智能,控制货运条件将十分困难.

Khi có ý định gửi hàng hóa thông qua hìn.en: When you intend to send goods through the form of railway transport, you should be familiar with the rail transport system. At the same time, he grasped the way the freight management system of that railway. That's how easy it is to manage, keep track of his goods.
Khi có ý định gửi hàng hóa thông qua hìn.zh: 拟通过铁路运输方式发货时,应当熟悉铁路运输系统. 与此同时,他掌握了那条铁路的货运管理系统。 这就是管理,跟踪他的货物是多么容易。

Khi đó, trong trường hợp số lượng hàng h.en: At that time, in the case of a large, diverse amount of goods. Archives for wide and large transport. Time off, short lift. So without the professional, intelligent freight management system, it's going to be difficult to manage goods on rail transport.
Khi đó, trong trường hợp số lượng hàng h.zh: 当时,对于数量巨大,种类繁多的货物. 广大运输档案. 休息时间,短电梯。 因此,如果没有专业的,智能的货运管理系统,铁路运输中的货物管理将十分困难.

Khó khăn thứ hai là không kiểm soát được.en: The second difficulty is that there is no control over the absolute goods, which are prone to risk of losing the goods. Because of the amount of goods. Without the system, the machine that controls the data, the risk of being lost, is understandable.
Khó khăn thứ hai là không kiểm soát được.zh: 第二个困难是,对绝对货物没有控制权,而绝对货物容易丢失货物。 因出货多. 没有系统,控制数据的机器,丢失的风险是可以理解的.

Khó khăn đầu tiên là không định vị được.en: The first difficulty is not to locate goods. The sender, the receiver will find it hard to know where his cargo is, what the state of transportation is. The acquisition was quite inconvenient and passive.
Khó khăn đầu tiên là không định vị được.zh: 第一个困难是不能找到货物。 发送者,接收者会发现很难知道他的货物在哪里,运输状况如何. 收购相当不方便和被动。

Mọi hàng hóa khi bị hư hỏng hoặc mất mát.en: All goods when damaged or lost, scratched, unbarred, and filed by the company's subjective error are paid 100% of the damage.
Mọi hàng hóa khi bị hư hỏng hoặc mất mát.zh: 受损或丢失,刮伤,无障碍,因公司主观错误而备案的商品,一律按100%赔偿损失.

Mọi thông tin như hàng hóa được vận chuy.en: All information such as freight is transported to where, the cargo car seat, the number of cargo waiting to be loaded... is updated in real time. The sender, receiver, and manager of the goods can easily grasp the real condition of the goods.
Mọi thông tin như hàng hóa được vận chuy.zh: 所有信息,如货运 运输到哪里,货车座, 等待装载的货物数量... 实时更新。 货物的发货人、接收人和管理人可以很容易地掌握货物的真实状况。

Ngoài ra, dịch vụ vận tải đường sắt của.en: Additionally, the 3rd Railway Transport Service, such as Liu Levi, also contains package-wide delivery forms: Cars to pick up supplies at the sender's home, take them to the station, line them with modern equipment, train them by rail to the receiver's terminal, the car transfers from the station to the receiver's.
Ngoài ra, dịch vụ vận tải đường sắt của.zh: 此外,第3铁路运输局,如刘列维,还载有包件全程交付表: 在发件人家中取货的汽车,带到车站,用现代设备排队,通过铁路训练到接收者的终点站,汽车从车站转移到接收者的终点站.

Nhờ hệ thống quản lý vận tải hàng hóa số.en: Thanks to this digital freight management system, the entire rail transport system is better managed. Templates, reports and statistics are carried out more quickly and more accurately.
Nhờ hệ thống quản lý vận tải hàng hóa số.zh: 由于这个数字货运管理系统,整个铁路运输系统得到了更好的管理. 模板、报告和统计工作进行得更快、更准确。
